Patient: Evelyn Marsh   DOB: 04/09/1954   MRN: 00551207
Phone: (555) 410-8823

Subjective: Follow-up of diabetes and kidney disease. Checks glucose twice daily, fasting readings 150 to 190.

Labs: A1c 8.2 today. eGFR 24, stable from 26 in December.

Assessment and plan:
1. Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease. A1c 8.2, not at goal. Increase insulin glargine to 24 units nightly.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4. eGFR 24. Nephrology follow-up in 6 weeks. Avoid NSAIDs.
3. Hyperlipidemia. Continue atorvastatin.

Patient: Joan Pruitt   DOB: 11/22/1957   MRN: 00672214
Callback: 555-208-6641

History: Right breast cancer treated with lumpectomy and radiation in 2019. Completed tamoxifen in 2024. No evidence of disease on last imaging. History of stroke in 2023 with no residual deficits, on aspirin.

Exam: Scattered expiratory wheezes bilaterally. Neurologic exam normal. Breast exam normal.

Assessment and plan:
1. COPD, moderate. FEV1 58% of predicted on spirometry today. Continue tiotropium daily and albuterol as needed.
2. History of breast cancer. Annual screening mammogram due in June.
3. History of stroke. Continue aspirin.
